I ran the `/code-conventions --review-pr` review against the 9 files in `682bd0ecd…HEAD`. I checked all 75 rules and 7 findings came out of it. None of them blocks the PR on its own, but the test gaps (findings 1 and 2) and the removed name tooltip (finding 3) are worth fixing before merge. I didn't need the extra lookup into past review comments for any rule.

The checklist script wrote `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, and I marked every item checked. It sits inside the untracked `docs/engineering/` directory, so no tracked files changed. It isn't gitignored yet, though, even though the skill's docs say it should be.

## Findings

**1. TEST-01 / TEST-04: the email tooltip is no longer tested** (medium)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/MembersList/index.test.tsx:80` (assertion at `:97`)
- The test is now named "truncates long member emails inside a tooltip trigger", but it only checks for the `truncate` class.
- The old hover check (`findByRole('tooltip', { name: longEmail })`) was removed and nothing replaced it after the switch from MUI to shadcn.
- If the `TooltipContent` in `MembersList/index.tsx:116-119` were deleted, no test would fail, so the name promises more than the test checks.
- **Fix:** hover the trigger and assert the tooltip shows the full email, or rename the test to match what it checks.

**2. TEST-02: new branches in `PaginatedDataTable` have no tests** (medium)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:32-44, 72-79, 89-91, 105`
The tests cover basic paging, resetting when rows change, and the asc → desc → off sort cycle. They don't cover:
- **Empty values:** `null`/`undefined` should always sort last, in both directions.
- **Sort resets paging:** clicking a header should return to page 0.
- **Page clamp:** when the data shrinks, the current page is clamped (`currentPage = Math.min(page, totalPages - 1)`) so the user isn't left on an empty page. The commit calls this "harden table paging".
- **Screen-reader sort state:** the `aria-sort` values.

The column-specific sort rules also have no tests: chain count in `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:39`, the middle column switching between `createdBy` and `updatedAt || createdAt` at `:46-47`, and email sorting in `MembersList/index.tsx:26`.

**3. UX-01 / UX-03 / PROD-01: dropping the name tooltip hides long contact names** (medium)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:63-67`
- Names are still cut off with `truncate` in a 20% column, but the tooltip that showed the full name is gone.
- The commit calls it "redundant", but it isn't when a name is actually cut off: there's now no way to read the full name.
- This is a visible behaviour change, so it needs explicit design sign-off in the PR description (PROD-01), or the tooltip should come back and only show when the name is cut off.

**4. PROD-01: the card borders were removed without a stated design reason** (low)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:181` and `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/Members/index.tsx:57`
- `border` was dropped from the address-book card, and the members card was restyled without one.
- The PR should mention the design decision (or link the Figma file) so reviewers know it's intentional and not accidental.

**5. CODE-04: one value is derived twice, and the columns are rebuilt on every render** (low)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:36-52, 47, 124`
- `entry.updatedAt || entry.createdAt` is written out twice: once in the sort function (`:47`) and once in the rendered cell (`:124`). A small helper would keep them from drifting apart.
- `columns` is rebuilt as a new array on every render and passed into the `useMemo` dependencies at `PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:87`. That means the memo never hits and the rows are re-sorted on every render. Wrapping `columns` in `useMemo` on `[hasMiddleColumn, showAddedBy]` fixes it.

**6. CODE-01: the unused shadcn pagination component is duplicated by hand** (low)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:135-160`
- `apps/web/src/components/ui/pagination.tsx` already exists but nothing uses it.
- The new generic table hand-builds its own prev/next buttons and range label instead. The hand-built version was carried over from the old address-book table.
- Now that this is the shared table component, it's a good point to either switch to the existing pagination component or note why it isn't used.

**7. Missing Playwright one-shot clickthrough (repo rule in AGENTS.md, advisory)** (low)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/MembersList/index.tsx:1`
- The PR changes web app code under `apps/web/src/**` but adds no one-shot clickthrough under `apps/web/e2e/tests/one-shots/`. Both the members table and the address-book table changed how they render, sort and paginate.
- **Fix:** add one, or note in the PR why it doesn't apply.

## Rules checked that the PR satisfies

- **FEAT-01 / FEAT-03 (feature boundaries):** imports inside the feature use relative paths, and nothing imports the feature's own entry file.
- **FEAT-04 (shared UI components):** no files under `components/ui/*` were edited.
- **UX-02 (actions on local rows):** the guard `!entry.isLocal && !entry.isPrivate` is kept.
- **OBS-01 (analytics labels):** `Track` labels are unchanged.
- **UI-01 (theme tokens):** only theme tokens are used (`text-destructive`, `text-muted-foreground`).
- **TEST-05 (test data):** tests use data builders, not network fixtures.

No other rule applied to this change.
